notes: THE PAGE WATCHES ITSELF. A request from the page has a deadline, a page that stops hearing from the program for half a minute reloads itself, a fault in the page is said on the page, and the live panel shows the second it last moved - the window no longer sits on the first second of a run. THE FILES ARE RENAMED INTO PLACE WITH A SHORT WAIT: on Windows the page reading the pool registry at the instant the downloader renamed the new one over it made that save fail (Access is denied); the rename now waits for the reader, and the page reads the registry only when it changed. Also in this build: one press makes one episode - the file picker closes the moment a file is chosen, the button says the plan is being made, a script an episode already holds opens that episode instead of making another.
